<STBG 100,0><BGM 0,0,504><NAME 7>I proclaim it, nya!
Your body is mine, nya;
my fate is your sword, nya!

Seven heavens clad in the three
great words, come from the ring
of restraint, guardian of scales, nya!

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,4>It was written in a book I picked up —
a spell to grant wishes, apparently, nya!
<MWT 3>Gwoooooooh

<CHAR 5,0,8,5,3><CV 2,5>We did it, nya!
The ritual succeeded for sure, nya!

<CHAR 5,4,8,4,0><CHAR 5,5,6,0,0><CHAR 1,5,8,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 12><CV 4,22><BGM 1,0,508><BGM 0,0,505>Big trouble!
A red-horned monster I've never
seen is on a rampage!

<TALK 1><NAME 9><CV 2,2>No way, nya!
The ritual was supposed to be perfect, nya!

<CV 2,8>I said the spell properly too, nya.
The timing, too...

<CV 2,3><CHAR 1,0,8,2,0>Nya nya!
You got the timing wrong, nya!!!

<TALK 5><NAME 12><CV 4,23>That's not all!
A lot of treasure appeared nearby!

<CV 4,27><ITEM PCOIN00051,1,1>According to the old texts, I think
it's the treasure of ≪Babylon≫,
but this can't be allowed.

Because of this ≪Babylon≫ treasure,
the island's treasure history
might be lost!

<ITEM 0,1,0><CV 4,7>Anyway, I want you to recover
the ≪Babylon≫ treasure no matter what.

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><CV 1,11><TALK 1><NAME 1>Understood!
We'll go.

<TALK 5><NAME 12><CV 4,28>I'm counting on you!
Recover the treasure and I'll give
you good equipment to match!

<ITEM WD_LSWORD176,1,1>Especially this weapon — it's said
to be modelled on a weapon that shone
in a similar crisis long ago.

Not just strong — it has the strange
effect of hiding its blade.

<ITEM 0,1,0><CV 4,18>It's strange gear, so do try to
collect it! Then, I leave it to you!

<CV 1,7><TALK 1><NAME 1>Yes!
Understood!
<CLS>
